# Ian Xiaohei Illustrations reference package

- Upstream: https://github.com/helloianneo/ian-xiaohei-illustrations
- Author: Ian (https://github.com/helloianneo)
- Snapshot commit: `4102eb807f03bcb6e538a16e8b31b41db8b5b954`
- Retrieved: 2026-10-12
- License: [MIT](LICENSE)
- Attribution notice: [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)

This is a selected local reference snapshot, not a global skill installation or a complete clone. It preserves the upstream skill, five reference documents, and three original style samples without modifications. The English networking/IT adaptation is documented in [the workspace style guide](../../docs/illustration-style.md).

## Included samples

- `ian-xiaohei-illustrations/assets/examples/03-sort-by-purpose.png`
- `ian-xiaohei-illustrations/assets/examples/05-handoff-path.png`
- `ian-xiaohei-illustrations/assets/examples/13-system-bearing.png`

These images use Chinese annotations and illustrate upstream article concepts. Use them to calibrate style, not as explanations of networking or IT behavior.
